g.text: A day's steps reaching Apple Health
Encrypted and MITM protected, or the watch
refuses the read, the write and the subscribe.
one STEPS point per step, ~400ms apart
merge contiguous points, up to 5 minutes
one median reading per minute, at its own time
Appended to a log on disk as they arrive.
Health Services publishes each point once and
keeps no history, so this is the only copy.
Delivering, a window at a time
the radio reports its queue emptied
write it off against the day's ledger
64 at a time because the link discards its whole
backlog past 512 chunks: one burst of a day's queue
overflowed, returned the batch, and burst again.
Measured: 800 messages in 12 seconds, none returned.
return the window to the front
one sample, over its own span
Retried on the next push, on unlock, on an
authorisation change, and on foreground. The
watch forgot it the moment the radio confirmed,
so dropping it would lose it outright.
day: the total, and what the belt delivered
the tiles, the resting rate, and the audit
ours < delivered is a write Health refused.
delivered < the watch's total is a delivery
that never arrived, and has no repair.
